body: CARDITH LORDA, the ageless Boy-King, leader of the Kuriotates in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human-seeming; boy; looks ten years old but is far older; small and slight, portrayed with dignity. Soft, boyish fair features, a small straight nose, smooth unlined skin, short neat dark-brown hair.
costume: royal robes of emerald green with gold trim and a high stiff collar, a jade seal on a gold chain, a slender gold circlet.
signature: His eyes are always cold, glinting GOLD-GREEN REPTILIAN EYES with narrow slit pupils, the one thing in his soft boyish face that is not a child's.
extra: He holds himself with an old man's stillness: no fidgeting, no wasted movement, his small hands slow and precise.

vibes.name: Serpent Eyes
vibes.line: Holding a fallen sparrow chick cupped in both small hands at his chest, a sweet child's smile, his gold-green slit-pupilled eyes lifted straight to the viewer, cold and glinting; a white marble garden court with a fountain, bright clear morning sun.
vibes.wears: a boy's light summer tunic of white linen embroidered at the neck with tiny green leaves, a pale green silk sash, a slender gold circlet.

vibes.name: Endless City
vibes.line: On a terrace, his right hand pressing his jade seal into green wax on a new charter, his left holding the parchment flat on the balustrade, chin lifted, a satisfied smile, eyes turned out over the city; green domes and gold roofs to every horizon under a clear noon sky.
vibes.wears: state regalia: a long mantle of cloth of gold over robes of pale jade-green silk, the jade seal on a heavy gold chain, a slender gold circlet.

vibes.name: Innocent Checkmate
vibes.line: His right hand setting a jade knight down for the killing move without a glance, his left loosely holding a captured ivory piece, head tilted, smiling warmly straight at the viewer; a council chamber at night, one hanging lamp over the board, an old advisor across it in shadow.
vibes.wears: a soft indoor coat of midnight-blue silk patterned with small silver stars over a plain white shirt with a ruffled collar, no crown.

vibes.name: Ageless Boy
vibes.line: His right hand pinning a gold brooch of honour to the sash of an old grey-bearded centaur guard who kneels before him and still towers over him, his left holding the sash flat, his child's face still, eyes ancient on the old centaur; a throne hall at violet dusk.
vibes.wears: a coronation robe centuries out of fashion, crimson and gold brocade faded and stiff with age, a tall ancient gold crown worn smooth by time.
